decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 049_08_000; 049_08_001; 049_08_010; 049_08_101;  049_08_110 REVB; 049_08_200 REVA; Site Location Plan and Cover Letter by Monmouth Planning dated 3.11.2025.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - No operational noise emitted from the commercial part of the development shall be audible at any residential/ noise sensitive premises. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises are not adversely affected by noise in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, CC1, D1, A1, and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - The rooflights hereby approved shall be fixed shut and permanently non?openable and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises are not adversely affected by noise in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, CC1, D1, A1, and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, details of high performance acoustically rated glazing shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall include the glazing specification, acoustic performance ratings, and confirmation that the proposed mitigation will achieve the appropriate internal noise levels in accordance with relevant British Standards. The mitigation measures shall be installed in full prior to occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises are not adversely affected by noise in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, CC1, D1, A1, and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the development, the proposed blinds fitted with automated light sensors shall be installed in full and shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development and the blinds shall be closed during nighttime operation unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises are not adversely affected by noise in accordance with the requirements of policies D1, A1, and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Reinstatement of glazed rooflights at ground floor roof level.
